lessons.trigger_condition: the v350 protected static-data candidate is correctly covered through PR #320 and main, but a later unrelated PR still compares freshness from the older v350 source main and re-flags the already-verified grading_company_updates.json change as stale
lessons.prevention_rule: after the verified v350 candidate merges, materialize a new Tablet GPT sync generation anchored to the resulting main merge SHA before evaluating later PRs; unrelated follow-up PRs then compare from that checkpoint while any subsequent watched-path change still fails closed
validation_required: source_main_sha equals the exact verified PR #320 main merge SHA
PR 320 merge SHA is an ancestor of the current head
the generation carries no model weights, raw grading calibration, or device-local runtime memory
the PLAYGO source repair remains a non-watched collector/data change and does not broaden freshness exclusions
any future watched-path change still reports TABLET_GPT_SYNC_STALE until a new verified generation exists
lessons.safety_boundary: do not ignore watched changes, do not broaden exclusions, do not auto-confirm UNKNOWN or CONFLICT values, and do not claim physical Tablet or Drive verification
